title: preflightCli describe block given a 150 s per-test timeout
severity_rationale: Test 4 runs the CLI twice under load; no assertion changed.

evidence.note: describe() gained the option { timeout: 150_000 } and a two-line comment. No assertion, title, import or mock changed. Reason: Found by 22-15 first full run. Test 4 starts the real CLI twice (21.9 s total under the full parallel run) on the integration project default 15 s test timeout, so it timed out with no assertion failing. Single-child Tests 1-3 took 11.1-13.3 s of the same 15 s. Each child already has its own 60 s kill limit in spawnRailedChild; the new per-test limit is two of those plus margin.

sibling_sites_checked: Every entry of rails-test-edits.json is registered individually or merged with its discovery. The diff of test/integration/preflightCli.test.ts was re-read against audit_base_sha.
